long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Milwaukee, Wiviott moved to Los Angeles after marrying Sharon Cohen. He developed a wide entrepreneurial career, but his clearest public business legacy was Eclipse Berry Farms, which he co-founded with produce merchant Norman Gilfenbain during the company's early development.

Eclipse joined growing, packing, shipping, marketing and processing under one operation. Its fields and facilities supported strawberry production across California and Mexico, giving Wiviott a vertically integrated platform in fresh produce. Gilfenbain initially managed the day-to-day business. After his co-founder died in 2013, Wiviott became chief executive and remained in that role until his own death in January 2017. His life also reflected sustained interests in philanthropy, travel and aviation; he maintained his pilot certification late into treatment for serious illness.
